faqs.q: What is the Fully Welded Trunnion Mounted Ball Valve, API 6D and what is it used for?
faqs.a: The Fully Welded Trunnion Mounted Ball Valve, API 6D is a fully welded trunnion mounted ball valve designed to API 6D, ASME B16.34, used for gas transmission and distribution, buried pipelines. It is listed in NPS 2" to 60" (DN50 to DN1500) and ASME Class 150 to 1500. The forged body halves are welded together around the ball, so there are no bolted body joints, and the valve weighs less than a bolted design.

faqs.q: How do I read the part numbers in the fully welded trunnion mounted ball valve size table, such as IH-PV-TBW-150-0200?
faqs.a: In the fully welded trunnion mounted ball valve size table the last four digits of the part number are the size in inches times 100 and the class code sits before them. IH-PV-TBW-150-0200 is 2" (DN50) in Class 150, and IH-PV-TBW-400-3200 is 32" (DN800) in Class 400.

faqs.q: What sizes and pressure classes does the Fully Welded Trunnion Mounted Ball Valve, API 6D come in?
faqs.a: The Fully Welded Trunnion Mounted Ball Valve, API 6D is published in NPS 2" to 60" (DN50 to DN1500), in ASME Class 150 to 1500. The size table lists 132 standard size and class combinations. Check size, class and end connection against the piping specification before you enquire.

faqs.q: What are the face-to-face lengths and weights of the fully welded trunnion mounted ball valve?
faqs.a: The fully welded trunnion mounted ball valve table gives lengths by size and class; in Class 150 the face-to-face length is 216 mm at 2" (DN50), 1092 mm at 22" (DN550) and 2170 mm at 48" (DN1200). Weight is 23 kg at 2", 2220 kg at 22" and 18360 kg at 48". The table lists lengths in millimetres; check the full row for the size and class you need.

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature is the Fully Welded Trunnion Mounted Ball Valve, API 6D rated for?
faqs.a: The fully welded trunnion mounted ball valve is offered in ASME Class 150 to 1500 and is listed for -46 °C to 200 °C. Those are pressure classes or nominal ratings, so the pressure you can actually use depends on the body material and temperature; send the design pressure and temperature and we confirm the class.

faqs.q: What materials is the Fully Welded Trunnion Mounted Ball Valve, API 6D made from?
faqs.a: Body material for the fully welded trunnion mounted ball valve is carbon steel, stainless steel, alloy steel, duplex. Seat and trim: spring-loaded seats, bi-directional. Construction: welded forged body, no body joints. Tell us the fluid and temperature when you enquire so we confirm the material.

faqs.q: What standards does the Fully Welded Trunnion Mounted Ball Valve, API 6D meet and what documents come with it?
faqs.a: The fully welded trunnion mounted ball valve is designed to API 6D, ASME B16.34 and is fire-safe to API 607 / API 6FA. Testing: hydrostatic shell and seat tests to API 6D. Material certificates and the pressure-test record are supplied with the valve, and third-party inspection and extra tests are added when the order specifies them.

faqs.q: What end connections and operator options does the Fully Welded Trunnion Mounted Ball Valve, API 6D have?
faqs.a: End connections on the fully welded trunnion mounted ball valve are butt-weld; RF or RTJ flanged. Operation is gear operator, pneumatic, electric or electro-hydraulic actuator. Our [actuated valves shelf](/c/actuated-valves) covers pneumatic, electric and electro-hydraulic actuators.

faqs.q: Can a fully welded trunnion mounted ball valve be repaired or buried?
faqs.a: The body of a fully welded trunnion ball valve cannot be opened, so the seats are chosen for long life and emergency sealant injection is fitted; such valves are typically designed to last the life of the pipeline. It can be buried: a stem extension brings the operator to grade, vent and sealant lines are extended too, and the body is coated for burial.

faqs.q: Where is the Fully Welded Trunnion Mounted Ball Valve, API 6D used?
faqs.a: The Fully Welded Trunnion Mounted Ball Valve, API 6D is used for gas transmission and distribution and buried pipelines, where a body joint would be a leak path that cannot be reached. The forged body halves are welded around the ball, so there are no bolted body joints and the valve weighs less than a bolted design.

faqs.q: How does a fully welded trunnion ball valve differ from a side entry or top entry valve?
faqs.a: The fully welded valve has no body joints and cannot be opened, whereas the [side entry valve](/p/side-entry-trunnion-mounted-ball-valve-api-6d) has a split body and the [top entry valve](/p/top-entry-trunnion-mounted-ball-valve-api-6d) lets seats and seals be replaced in place through a bolted top cover. Choose fully welded for buried service where nothing needs to be reached; our [floating vs trunnion guide](/blog/floating-vs-trunnion-mounted-ball-valves) covers the wider choice.

faqs.q: When do I need metal seats in a trunnion mounted ball valve?
faqs.a: Choose metal seats where solids, scale or sand would cut soft seats, above the temperature limit of polymer seats, and on emergency shutdown valves where a seal must hold after long periods without operating. The Metal Seated Trunnion Mounted Ball Valve uses tungsten or chrome carbide hardfacing on the ball and seats and is listed to 450 °C.

faqs.q: Why are some rows of the metal seated trunnion ball valve table reduced bore?

Use metal seats for abrasive, hot or emergency shutdown service and soft seats for clean gas and liquids.

faqs.q: What does the Trunnion Mounted Double Block and Bleed Compact Ball Valve do in one body?
faqs.a: It puts two trunnion balls and a bleed in one body, so two independent isolations and the bleed that proves the seal come in a fraction of the length and weight of two valves and a bleed. It is used for offshore, marine and process isolation, in a long or short pattern.

faqs.q: How does the compact double block and bleed ball valve differ from a standard trunnion ball valve?
faqs.a: A standard trunnion valve such as the [side entry soft seated valve](/p/side-entry-trunnion-mounted-ball-valve-api-6d) has one ball and relies on both seats for a double block and bleed, while the compact valve carries two balls and a bleed in one body for independent isolation. Its published range is NPS 2 to 24 against NPS 2 to 60.

faqs.q: Can I get the Trunnion Mounted Double Block and Bleed Compact Ball Valve supplied from Dubai, and how do I order?
